name: robot
description: A little ASCII robot that walks, dances and plays above your Claude Code prompt — and in your terminal

robot.title: Robot
robot.description: The animated robot above the prompt. false hides it, as /robot does, and keeps the status line.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: A line under the prompt: account | model [effort] | project | branch | 7d and 5h limits with time left | cost | context % | ❄ cache cold.

contextFire.title: Context on fire
contextFire.description: When the context passes the fire level, the robot's head catches fire and it reminds you to /compact. false keeps the normal animations always.

hotAt.title: Fire at (% context)
hotAt.description: Context usage, in percent, at which the robot's head catches fire. Empty means 25.

cacheCold.title: Cache cold
cacheCold.description: After a break long enough for the prompt cache to expire, ice cubes gather around the robot and the status line shows ❄ cache cold with the context your next message re-reads at full price. false turns both off.

cacheTtl.title: Cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache lives after the last request: 1h, 5m, or auto (5m until a chat shows a 1-hour cache).

compactFactory.title: Compacting factory line
compactFactory.description: While the conversation compacts, robots and WALL-Es pack themselves into boxes on a factory line.

gitCheer.title: Git cheer
gitCheer.description: The robot cheers when a git commit or push goes through.

subagentFriends.title: Subagent friends
subagentFriends.description: A WALL-E friend rolls in for each running subagent, up to 3.

limitWindows.title: Limits shown
limitWindows.description: Which rate limits the status line shows: both, 5h or 7d.

limitsAt.title: Limits from (% used)
limitsAt.description: Rate-limit usage, in percent, from which a limit shows in the status line. 0 shows it always.

needsYou.title: Needs you
needsYou.description: When Claude ends its turn on a question, the robot says "need a human" in a bubble until you send your reply.

robotSpinner.title: Robot spinner words
robotSpinner.description: Replaces the spinner word (Sauteing…) with robot words.

branchWave.title: Branch wave
branchWave.description: A bright band shimmers across the branch name for 3 seconds when the branch changes, and after a git commit or push. false keeps it still.

agentLines.title: Subagent lines
agentLines.description: While subagents run, one line for each under the status line: its task, type, model, tokens and time, up to 3. false hides them.

changedFiles.title: Changed files
changedFiles.description: One line under the status line: how many files git would commit; with a PR open, all the PR's files, committed or not, with the lines added and removed. Click it, or run /robot files, for the list. false hides it.

resetSettings.title: Reset all settings to default
resetSettings.description: Set to true and save: every robot setting goes back to its default, and this switch goes back to false.
